papers.summary: Proposes a nuclear-norm-based spectral weight-decay update and reports lower effective rank and better low-rank compression at matched validation loss.

evidence.quote: spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss

papers.title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights

papers.summary: Approximates a relaxed Muon objective for low-rank adapters and evaluates sMuon in fine-tuning and a ReLoRA pretraining experiment.

evidence.quote: approximating the solution to a relaxed Muon objective in the low-rank setting via linearization and then least-squares

papers.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters

papers.summary: Normalizes LoRA down-projection matrices during training or at initialization to alter early optimization dynamics.
papers.relevance: Addresses practical LoRA optimization and stability.

evidence.quote: Because LoRA initializes the up-projection to zero, its early optimization dynamics are largely governed by the down-projection.

papers.title: Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation

papers.summary: Learns subspaces to discard jointly under a model-level objective, then merges the resulting projectors into low-rank factors.
papers.relevance: Relevant to preserving quality under low-rank weight compression.

evidence.quote: All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective--the KL divergence to the dense model's output distribution or the model's original training loss--while the pretrained weights remain frozen.

papers.title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression
